notes: §1985:VII.4.7.4 GR16: "If the ADVANCING phrase is not used, automatic advancing will be provided by the implementor to act as if the user had specified AFTER ADVANCING 1 LINE", then items a-h for the phrase. WriteRecord reroutes a WRITE without the phrase to WriteAdvancingRecord (1 line, AFTER) whenever SupportsVerticalPositioning holds (a LINAGE clause, or AdvancingDeclared, set from the OPEN for a file whose program writes any ADVANCING phrase, kb/Work PB5201 landed); ExternalFileConnectorRules.ShareAdvancing shares the fact across the describing units of one compilation group (kb/Work PB5570 landed); Position, PositionOnLogicalPage, BeginNextLogicalPage, Advance, WriteTravel and Present carry items a-h. Re-read 2026-11-15 (registrar landing records-1985-reread): holds on one program (work-a/r6/main.cob, bytes 0A-41-31-0D-41-32-0A-0A-0A-41-33-0D-41-34-0C-41-35-0A-41-36-0A: plain, BEFORE 2, AFTER 1, AFTER 0 overprinting by CR, AFTER PAGE form feed, plain) and across a compilation group (work-a/r6/group.cob; PB5570). kb/Work PB5766 (decided 2026-11-16, wave 20262068): an EXTERNAL describer compiled APART is consulted from its activation (FileRegistry.Register) or its first ADVANCING write, not before, so the opener's plain WRITEs made before it are bare records; which files support vertical positioning is the implementor's and the determination docs/conformance/4/WRITE-WITHOUT-ADVANCING.md now states this arm; witness pb5766_external_advancing_separate_unit (P1 P2 bare, A2 after two line feeds, P3 after one, read back as one 20-byte record). The witnesses run LINAGE-COUNTER through a, c, g and the omitted phrase, the plain-first file, the EXTERNAL file of one group and of two separately compiled units; each MATCHES.
